method: Frozen harder variants before one development trial; development selection and crate contracts before exposed reserved scoring. Native pinned MiniLM, threshold .3, limit eight, budget 1000, short-query scale 11/12 for two words. Historical baseline outputs reuse verified identical runtime source; all candidate views replayed.
limitations: Eight reused, exposed source incidents; correlated query variants, no independent semantic or live-agent claim.
Capacity-infeasible retention cases excluded from recall headline. Guard every previously delivered required fact and rank.
Unrequested trailing records may be replaced; fixture retention is not universal precision proof. Concurrent checks do not establish latency improvement.
